---
title: "Setbacks, Progress, and Project Growth"
date: "2026-4-30"
image: slides/AppImage.png
---

One of the biggest setbacks during this project was balancing feature ambition with development time. I initially planned more 
advanced account systems and external integrations, but I later scaled back certain features to ensure the core experience 
remained polished and reliable. Another challenge involved debugging UI issues in SwiftUI, particularly with charts and dynamic 
layouts across different device sizes. Despite these setbacks, the project showed consistent progress throughout both the 
600-level and 610-level courses. Over time, the application evolved from a basic workout logger into a more complete platform 
with workout evaluations, achievement systems, progress visualization, and personalized feedback features.

Looking back on the project as a whole, I can clearly see how much both the application and my technical skills developed over 
time. Working through setbacks forced me to improve my debugging, planning, and decision-making abilities, especially when 
adapting to unfamiliar frameworks and technologies. The steady progress made across both courses demonstrated the value of 
long-term iteration and persistence in software engineering projects. By the end of the process, the project represented not 
only a completed application, but also a reflection of my growth as a computer science student and developer.
